allOf.description: CloudEvents 1.0 context attributes; every attribute is required in this fleet.

id.description: UUID v4, minted once per occurrence and stable across outbox redelivery.

subject.description: Aggregate instance id; equal to the Kafka message key.

path_id.description: Process path id, resolved against the process-path catalogue.

ref.description: Release reference. For order-originated work this is the order id; it is kept on the Task and published as TaskCompleted.order_ref (ADR-0040). For transfer work it is the demand id. For RELOCATE work it is the slot plan id and is not kept (ADR-0047).

line_no.description: Optional (additive; the event stays v1). The 1-based order line this work unit is for; wes-work-planning sets it for order-originated work (explicitly, not encoded in work_unit_id). It is kept on the Task as source_line_no and published as TaskCompleted.line_no (ADR-0041). Absent from producers that predate it, and never honoured for transfer work. A value above 2147483647 (the 32-bit column width) is ignored by this consumer rather than rejected, so the task is still created with its line unknown.

transfer_ref.description: Present only for inter-warehouse-transfer work (the transfer saga's correlation id). Its presence turns the created Task into transfer work whose completion publishes exactly one transfer fact.

work_kind.description: Kind of transfer work; selects the completion fact. Required whenever transfer_ref is present, unknown values are rejected.

site_id.description: Site the transfer fact is about (origin for pick/dispatch, destination for arrival).

quantity.description: Units of sku the transfer moves.

relocation.description: Present ONLY on work released on the RELOCATE process path (ADR-0047; additive, the event stays v1). One move of an approved slot plan (slotting-optimization SlotPlanApproved, planned by wes-work-planning). It turns the created Task into a RELOCATE task whose completion takes the operator-confirmed quantity and scanned bins and publishes them on TaskCompleted. A RELOCATE release without this object, this object on any other path, or an object that is not a valid move (missing move_seq, unknown kind, a bin the kind requires missing, from_bin equal to to_bin, blank plan_id or sku) is rejected and dead-lettered; no task is created.

move_seq.description: The move's 0-based position in SlotPlanApproved.data.moves. With plan_id it forms the move reference `<plan_id>:<move_seq>` published as TaskCompleted.relocation_ref (keep plan_id + move_seq within 200 characters).

kind.description: The SlotPlanApproved move kind, exact case. Relocate needs from_bin and to_bin; Assign needs to_bin (the source is scanned at completion); Vacate needs from_bin (the reserve destination is scanned at completion).

sku.description: The SKU to move (SlotPlanApproved move sku).

from_bin.description: Source bin (SlotPlanApproved move from_slot). Omitted for an Assign (the operator scans the source); if sent for an Assign it is fixed.

to_bin.description: Destination bin (SlotPlanApproved move to_slot). Omitted for a Vacate (the operator scans a reserve bin); if sent for a Vacate it is fixed.
